caption: Piazza del Campo, Siena
composition: Shell-shaped Piazza del Campo toward Palazzo Pubblico and Torre del Mangia · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The tourist stands in the great shell of the Campo, its brick paving curving across the foreground toward the Palazzo Pubblico center-right, crowned by the slender Torre del Mangia. Curved ranks of palazzi close the square on the left and right, their ground-floor arches in shadow. At 09:00 the morning sun rakes across the right half of the piazza, leaving the left side in cool shadow under a pale blue sky.
